description: A quiet sanctuary suspended between the physical and written worlds. The air vibrates with the hum of ancient syntax. Floating letter-blocks orbit a central sphere of pure language. A portal shimmers to the west, back toward the Peak of Misery. Willy squints: 'This is where language itself was first solidified into matter. Careful — don't sneeze, or you might accidentally conjugate something.'

wall.description: Shifting walls constructed of massive, slowly rotating letter-blocks that spell out words you almost recognise.

floor.description: A stable floor paved with soft parchment-like tiles. Each step leaves a faint ink impression of your footprint.

portal_of_misery.description: A swirling distortion leading back west to the Peak of Misery. The cold mountain air seeps through it.

lexicon_sphere.description: A glowing sphere constructed entirely of pure alphabetic characters orbiting in complex grammatical patterns. It pulses warmly when you approach.
lexicon_sphere.onInteract:
You press your hand against the Lexicon Sphere. Letters swarm around your fingers like warm fireflies. A deep, resonant voice speaks directly into your mind:

'In the beginning was the Word. Then came the Shoe. Then came the Scream. These three forces shaped all of Screaming Fred's world — language to name things, objects to hold them, and sound to shake them loose when they got stuck.'

Willy leans in, visibly moved: 'That's... actually remarkably coherent for a floating sphere.' Freddista gives it a thumbs up.

The sphere grants you a moment of deep Textlandian clarity — you feel strangely certain you are exactly where you are supposed to be.

item.name: Lexicon Shard
item.description: A warm crystallised fragment of the Lexicon Sphere. It pulses faintly and smells faintly of old books and fresh ink.
item.opened_description: The Lexicon Sphere hums contentedly, having shared its wisdom.
item.onCollect: A small shard of the sphere breaks off and floats into your hand. It feels warm and hums softly. Willy says: 'Keep it. It may prove useful for something linguistic later.'

floating_letters.description: A cluster of large floating letter-blocks slowly orbiting the sphere. You can make out fragments of words — 'SCRE', 'AMFL', 'OOR' — that almost form something meaningful.
